metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: FUZREZ crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C68 H206 Dy27 O133 13+,13(Cl1 O4 1-),61(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy7 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy9 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy12 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy13 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy14 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy15 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy16 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy17 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy18 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy19 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy20 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy21 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy22 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy23 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy24 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy25 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy26 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy27 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 59 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.468-4.058 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 90.29-118.54°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [ClO4@Dy27(μ3-OH)32(CO3)8(CH3CH2COO)20(H2O)40](ClO4)12·50H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 32 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 40 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
